Settings → Scanner → Wedge → Intent Wedge: enable, action as above, delivery Broadcast.

Scanner → Output mode: Broadcast. Turn keyboard emulation off.

The app listens to every profile at once — there is no vendor to pick. The list is here so you can find the instructions for your terminal.
If your terminal is not listed: almost every scanner service lets you name the action in its own settings. Type the same name here.

Enter the address of the computer running Markiro Standalone and the code from the office. Or press the trigger and scan the pairing barcode.
Compare it with the fingerprint on the office screen. The code is sent only if they match.
The server\'s certificate has changed. Do not confirm unless the office replaced the computer or restored data from a backup.
An address is four numbers from 0 to 255, for example 192.168.1.10.
The code has 10 characters: digits and Latin letters without U. Check it on the office screen.
The server does not answer. Check Wi-Fi and the address. The code was not used.

Too many attempts. Wait and issue a new code.
The license has no free seats for handhelds.
Handheld support is not enabled in the office.

Could not pair the device. Try again.

No link to the host — work continues
The host is being restored from a backup — work continues
